summary: Revised implementation plan for ElevenLabs x Shopify Headless Checkout Integration (Phase 1), incorporating: 1) Pinned Storefront API version from config/environment (2024-07 / 2025-01 dynamic fallback), 2) Clear boundary that _tribal_exemption_requested cart attribute is for Shopify Flow downstream tagging and post-purchase Avalara tax processing rather than immediate checkout calculation, and 3) /api/agent/refresh-checkout endpoint for generating fresh, non-stale checkoutUrls before QR code rendering.
